outputs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a COLOR-ONLY production sprite-sheet edit.
Image1 is the edit target, image2 is the user-approved saturated Lu Bu concept.
Change ONLY the character palette of image1 to match image2: vivid clean SCARLET red cape and helmet plumes (not pale coral/pink), rich bright GOLD armor (not cream/yellow pastel), strong ORANGE-CHESTNUT horse (not pale peach), medium warm brown hair/mane, light natural peach skin, silver halberd. Increase saturation distinctly while keeping light readable values. Clean thin warm-brown contour, simplified flat cel shading. Do NOT darken everything, add black shadow blocks, thicken lines, add engraving, glow, dust or any effects.
Crucial invariants: absolutely preserve every pose, silhouette, cell position, camera, scale, face shape, hand/weapon orientation, four horse limbs, crop bounds, and transparent spacing. No new poses, no removed cells, no added weapons. Original upper-body alignment must stay exact; these are registered animation frames, not illustrations. Preserve REAL transparent alpha background; no black/white fill, no checkerboard, no text, borders or guides.
Keep exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, all 12 action sprites in their exact existing order. Preserve front/rear views and all charging/braking/sweeping gestures.
references: previous v6.4 source, palette replaced with user approval
